title: Be an accredited commercial passenger vehicle operator
what: Be accredited as an operator before operating a commercial passenger vehicle, which includes a passenger bus.

sources.title: Commercial Passenger (Road) Transport Act 1991 (NT)
sources.locator: provision headed 'Operator to be accredited' (current reprint)
sources.quote: A person must not operate a commercial passenger vehicle, either alone or as part of or in connection with any other business, unless the person is accredited under this Part or has an exemption under section 15(1).
